context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_11 confirms all iteration_10 dark-mode HIGH bugs are fixed. If future dark-mode work is done, the two remaining low-priority observations are: (1) /admin booking-row action pill buttons (Confirm/Mark Done/Cancel) — pale-on-pale; (2) /checkout 'Complete your order.' hero heading contrast. Both are DESIGN polish not functional blockers.
rca of the issue: Root cause was previously identified in iteration_10: shadcn DialogContent portals outside the app tree so the .bg-white utility override wasn't hitting the correct specificity, and admin KPI/filter classes used inline hex colors ([#1A1A1A], bg-white) that lost cascade. Fix strategy: add explicit [data-theme='dark'] [role='dialog'] + [data-theme='dark'] .kbs-card .font-serif-kbs + button.rounded-full.bg-white targeted rules with !important. All confirmed working via computed-style inspection.
